method: Native1536x1024 visual inspection with view_image, plus read-only in-memory magnifications of the Eiffel antenna and landmark feet. No image files were changed or created. Approximate visual bounds, not segmented pixel measurements. Coordinates originate at top-left; bbox=[left,top,right,bottom]. Width includes the full outer ground/plinth span, not only the front-facing foot or central arch.
baseCenterDefinition: The x value is the midpoint of the total visible base span. Base-center y is the midpoint of the visible ground/plinth envelope, not an inferred physical ground-plane centroid. The lowest footing is reported separately.
instructionInterpretation: One take per tile and no position/anchor iteration. Small width overshoot is allowed in principle by the source, but the receiver KS+PT must assess the actual result. Eiffel must have the complete tower in one tile with continuation in its neighbor. Raw delivery does not constitute receiver acceptance.

measurements.topTipUncertainty: The actual terminal point is outside the frame. Its y coordinate and missing length cannot be recovered from this image.

contentObservations: A single recognizable Eiffel Tower, main lattice body, platforms, broad arches and ground feet are present in the intended riverside park district.

The upper antenna is actually clipped. In the source-pixel enlargement x395..450,y0..90, a finite-width vertical shaft intersects the top border with no visible terminal cap or tapered end. This is not an intact tip merely touching the edge.
The main tower body and feet are visible, but the complete tower including its terminal antenna is not contained in this tile. The clipped extent is unknown.
geometryObservations: Total base width is about555 px versus500 px. This is a scale discrepancy, not evidence of a wrong-block placement.
Base center is approximatelyx417. The lowest/front footing is approximatelyy908. These independently estimated values are approximate and do not imply an exact seam match.
images.receiverReviewLimitation: The true missing antenna tip must be disclosed separately from the approximately11 percent base-width overshoot. A full-tower claim is unsupported. Whether to retain this cropped antenna is a KS+PT receiver decision; no regeneration or final acceptance is authorized by this QA report.

measurements.topTipUncertainty: Tower tip and upper structure are intentionally outside this continuation tile; no tip coordinate can be measured here.

Cropping of the upper tower is expected in this lower continuation; this tile does not restore the missing terminal antenna of r07c07.
geometryObservations: Base width and horizontal center are visually consistent with r07c07 within measurement uncertainty.

With the715 px vertical tile step, the measured r07c07 lowest footing y908 predicts y193 here; the observed approximately192 differs by about1 px, well inside uncertainty. This is an approximate landmark-footing check, not a full overlap or seam validation.
images.receiverReviewLimitation: Shares the approximately555 px Eiffel base scale rather than the nominal500 px. Receiver must assess the combined landmark and neighboring seam; this report does not establish final assembly acceptance.

The full visible monument including its roof ornament and lowest footing is inside the frame; no clipping is observed.
